reportedFailure.screenshot: Windows source browser is unavailable; black screen, 0:00 / 0:00, episode 53
reportedFailure.stage: Native WebView2 source-browser initialization, before decoder media open
reportedFailure.notTheSameAsIssue7: Issue7 was a nonfatal FFmpeg log shown over continuing video
reportedFailure.uncertainty: Old code discarded the exact stage and HRESULT. The reporter supplied no playback source or original native code; this workstation reproduction proves a matching failure class, not the unique cause on the reporter's machine.

investigation.shortPathBaseline: Actual WebView2: 35 sequential, 4 concurrent and 10 initialization-cancel/reopen operations passed
investigation.singleVariableCheck: Reducing intermediate path from 80 characters to 10 while retaining Unicode, cold directory and cookie-store checks passed
investigation.fixedDeepPath: Original directory and cookies retained; same-directory Windows extended path used, canonical identity strips prefix before comparison; shared environment per source directory. Initial 8.3 alias workaround passed locally but failed on hosted runner, so removed.
investigation.limitations: No anonymous replacement, junction, credential move or TLS bypass. Original reporter machine code was discarded by the previous version; verified client startup classes do not establish the unique original machine failure.

codeReview.defect: Every operation constructed an independent environment for the same source directory; initialization was not coordinated
codeReview.change: One canonical-directory environment, coalesced creation, independent cancellable controllers

codeReview.defect: Generic Failed erased environment/controller/script/cookie failure codes
codeReview.change: Safe stage plus exact HRESULT; no URL, local user path, cookie or credentials in diagnostic details

codeReview.defect: Cancelled pending controller could still be allocated after close
codeReview.change: Terminal closed state is checked both before controller creation and in callback; cancelled created controller closed
Process exit invalidates shared environment and pending resolver; explicit retry recreates; only fixture browser process terminated in regression

codeReview.defect: VideoController.waitUntilFirstFrameRendered completes once per controller, not each file
codeReview.change: DesktopPlaybackSession serializes stop/open and waits for actual current media time-pos/idle status

codeReview.defect: Source-line changes used resolve generation while outer result publication checked only load generation
codeReview.change: Line choices have current load generation and captured directory; switching increments load identity; stale sheet/results cannot publish

codeReview.defect: Old resolver was not cancelled until history/content loads completed
codeReview.change: Episode retry/switch cancels immediately; asynchronous completion/save transitions check current load identity

adoptedPrinciples: Reuse browser infrastructure rather than booting each resolve
Serialize operations sharing mutable playback state
Separate session ownership and revoke stale results
Distinguish resolver failure, decoder failure and diagnostic logs
notCopied: Narrow log substring errors as universal fatal classification

browser: different source cannot read synthetic cookie
browser process death becomes explicit failure then retry succeeds
invalid profile file reports stage/HRESULT without leaking its path
decoder: actual mpv nonfatal diagnostic during play
held HTTP bytes do not inherit previous readiness
superseded open cannot replace next media

testHarnessCorrection: Invalid-profile negative fixture initially let a regular file path reach WebView2, causing the user-visible Edge data-directory modal. Native directory and exclusive-write preflight now rejects it before Edge startup. Test hosts were stopped; no user browser data was changed. Terminal decoder ownership now follows on_load/on_unload lifecycle events rather than transient idle sampling alone.
